articles.title: Germany's Merz warns attackers will 'pay price' after drone incident
articles.description: A drone attack on Leipzig Airport highlights the "very real threat" faced by the country, the German chancellor says.

articles.title: No one held accountable one year after Israeli double strike on Gaza hospital
articles.description: A year on from an Israeli double strike on a hospital in Gaza that killed 22 Palestinians, including journalists and rescue workers, no one has been held accountable.
